message.content:
Streaming media boxes without tuners have been classified in CBP rulings under 8517.62.0090 (other apparatus for reception, conversion and transmission of data), though some rulings place them in 8528.71 (reception apparatus for television, not designed to incorporate a video display) — but that applies only to devices with a tuner. Without a tuner, 8528.71 is out because it covers apparatus that incorporate a tuner. Roku-type devices were classified in 8517.62.0090 in some rulings, and in others in 8521.90 (video recording or reproducing apparatus). Xumo Stream Box rulings (NY N3xxxxx) classified it under 8517.62.0090, I believe. The streaming device receives data via the Internet and converts it to video, so I'll go with 8517.62.0090.

{"hts_code": "8517.62.0090", "reason": "A tunerless internet streaming media receiver is a machine for the reception, conversion and transmission of data, classified in subheading 8517.62 as other apparatus (statistical suffix 0090)."}
